svg.title: Why the exceptional 28 cubes cannot build a three-colour target
svg.desc: Seven copies of each of four cube varieties share one orientation on every colour triple and lack its reverse. A target with a trichromatic corner needs both orientations. A target without such a corner needs eight cubes with the same repeated colour, but only seven are available.

g.text: Monochromatic corner; fold the nets away from you.
Read each corner counterclockwise from outside.
A target with a trichromatic corner
C Targets with no trichromatic corners
Eight corners need eight distinct cubes.
Only seven cubes can supply them.
